name: io.github.jameselle/sockodds-mcp
title: SockOdds
description: Australian sports odds from SockOdds API v1: bookmaker prices, best price and no-vig fair odds.

environmentVariables.name: SOCKODDS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your SockOdds API key, sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. A free key is available at https://sockodds.com/signup/

environmentVariables.name: SOCKODDS_DEMO
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to try the tools with invented sample data and no key. Ignored when a key is set.

environmentVariables.name: SOCKODDS_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: Time zone for start times (UTC is always shown too)
